{{Quote|We Rattataki live to fight.|Osika Kirske, to [[Meltch Krakko]]|<ref name="Restraint">{{StoryCite|story=Restraint|book=Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter}}</ref>}}
'''Osika Kirske''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Vollick/Legends|Vollick]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] on [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]] who once ruled more than half the planet. He killed [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]' foster parents when she was an infant, as well as Asajj's master, [[Ky Narec/Legends|Ky Narec]], with the help of a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] raider. Years later, Asajj, then a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], returned to [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]] and defeated Osika Kirske.

==Biography==
{{Quote|All my life, I had only known victory in war. I conquered many cities and killed many of my rivals.|Osika Kirske, to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Republic 60">[[Republic 60|''Republic'' 60]]</ref>}}
===Early campaigns===
[[File:Asajjventressheadshot-obsession.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Kirske was imprisoned by Ventress on her fortress on Rattatak.]]
During his early military career, Kirske became one of the most powerful warlords on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]]. The planet knew nothing of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], nor of peace; local warlords had fought one another for personal power for centuries in a never-ending conflict. One of these was Osika Kirske. A seasoned fighter and strategist, the Rattataki only knew victory, defeating [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress's]] foster parents after they attempted to raise an army against him on the southern part of the planet. Asajj herself managed to escape, becoming an apprentice to [[Ky Narec/Legends|Ky Narec]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] emissary who had also managed to escape Kirske's forces after his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] crash-landed on Rattatak. Together, they became a near unstoppable Jedi and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] team, quickly rallying supporters to their cause and inflicting defeat after defeat upon those who opposed them.

===The tide turns===
Dismayed by these turn of events and rumors of Ventress's new powers, Kirske entered upon a temporary truce with the other [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] of [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]], and attempted to kill both [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and [[Ky Narec/Legends|Ky Narec]]. Half of the plan succeeded. Ironically, by hiring a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] raider to successfully kill the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], Kirske brought about his own downfall. Driven to hatred and the dark side after being cruelly bereaved a second time by the same individual, Ventress destroyed both Kirske's and the other warlords' forces, taking the [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] prisoner as a trophy. Asajj became in command of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

===Imprisonment===
Kirske escaped after [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] caused a mass prison break in his attempt to escape Ventress's grip. Aiding Kenobi, Kirske showed himself to be a bloodthirsty and vicious [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], telling the Jedi of his plans to destroy both Ventress and her attempts to rebuild Rattatak. He was quickly dispatched by his nemesis after the Dark Jedi [[Sai cha/Legends|beheaded]] the cruel warlord with ease. This however, helped Obi-Wan and [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha-17]] to escape.
